name: page-cards
description: Card grid for the 2026 company and resource pages: centred eyebrow, heading and intro over 2 to 4 columns of white cards in one of four looks — icon (an SVG icon in a tinted tile that takes the card's brand colour), number (numbered steps joined by a rule), badge (an award or partner badge with a list of links) or plain — each with a title, copy with inline links, optional link list or whole-card link; then optional buttons and small print. Cards rise in on scroll.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

tone.description: Section background: white, or slate-50 with brand orbs.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title.description: Heading (h2). Empty renders the cards alone (then card titles are h2).

intro.description: Copy under the heading. Blank line = new paragraph; [label](url) links, **bold**.

look.description: icon: SVG icon tile; number: numbered steps (number pill, icon on the right, a rule joining the cards on desktop); badge: centred badge image and link list (awards); plain: title and copy only.

columns.description: Cards per row from 1101px (two on tablets, one on phones; badge cards stay two-up on phones).

items.description: Cards. Each: title (the card heading; may be empty only when body is set), body (blank line = new paragraph; [label](url), **bold**), icon_svg (inline SVG; strokes and fills set to currentColor take the accent colour) or icon (image URL), image + image_alt + image_w + image_h (badge look: the badge picture), number (number look: the pill text, e.g. 1), accent (indigo, green, yellow, red, violet; default cycles in that order), links (array of {label, url}: small link list), url + link_label (an arrow link; the whole card becomes the link).

cta_label.description: Primary (gradient) button under the grid. Renders only with cta_url.

secondary_label.description: Secondary (outline) button. Renders only with secondary_url.

note.description: Small print under the grid (blank line = new paragraph; [label](url), **bold**).
